functions.name: GameBeing_OnDeadStateChanged
functions.notes: BSF_Dead handler — toggles interaction type, fires Event_Entity_InteractionUpdate. Score ceiling limited by __thiscall void* structural deductions.

functions.name: GameBeing_GetInteractionConfig
functions.notes: Returns 4-slot interaction descriptor array. If pThis+0x158 bit0 (BSF_Dead) is set, fills all slots with loot descriptor. Else switches on entity class tag at pThis+0x13c.

functions.name: GameBeing_ApplyDeadInteraction
functions.notes: Applies death-state color tint to CharacterName widget. UI-layer only, does not modify simulation state.

functions.name: SGWScriptedWindow_ParseBeginAidWaitEvent
functions.notes: Parses onBeginAidWait event: reads TimeToAid + respawners array (respawnerID + respawnerName per entry), pushes to Lua, fires callback. Score ceiling from 51 undefined locals — structurally unfixable complex function.

functions.name: SGWScriptedWindow_OnBeginAidWait_Dispatch
functions.notes: Thin dispatch thunk — reads pThis+0x8/0xc/0x10, calls SGWScriptedWindow_ParseBeginAidWaitEvent.

functions.name: Lua_callForAid
functions.notes: Lua C binding. Validates 2 args, reads respawnerID, calls EmitNetOut_callForAid. Full wire path: PlayerDefeat.lua -> callForAid -> Lua_callForAid -> EmitNetOut_callForAid -> RouteOutgoingEntityRpc -> cell method 67 (CALL_FOR_AID).

functions.name: EmitNetOut_callForAid
functions.notes: Pattern-B NetOut emitter. scalable_malloc(0xc) + EventNetOut_callForAid_Ctor + SetField(respawnerID) + CmeEventSignal dispatch. Documented in prior session.

functions.name: EmitNetOut_GiveRespawner
functions.notes: Pattern-B NetOut emitter. Reads RespawnerMobId from entity data, allocates Event_NetOut_GiveRespawner (0xc bytes), sets aRespawnerMobID field, dispatches via FUN_00cace50.

functions.name: EventNetOut_GiveRespawner_Ctor
functions.notes: Pattern-B Ctor. 12-byte event object. NetworkEvent_Ctor -> NetworkEvent::vftable -> Event_NetOut_GiveRespawner::vftable (double-overwrite MSVC pattern). vtable at 0x019B37E0.

functions.name: RouteOutgoingEntityRpc
functions.notes: Documented in prior sessions (W-world-entry / address-map). Routes outgoing entity method calls. Cell methods: bits 0-1 of pArgData+0x1c = 0. Base methods: bits = 2.

functions.name: GameBeing_RightClickGatePredicate
functions.notes: Documented in prior session (W-right-click-routing). Gate predicate: reads pThis+0x158 bit0 (BSF_Dead) to allow corpse looting.

functions.name: GameBeing_OnStateFieldUpdate
functions.notes: Documented in W-state session. XOR-delta dispatch: computes changed bits, routes each set bit to per-flag handler. BSF_Dead dispatched here.

key_findings: Corpse model: NO separate corpse entity spawned. BSF_Dead (bit 0, pThis+0x158) flip on existing entity. Ragdoll via kismet Entity_Death sequence (5001) — client-side actor physics change.

onBeginAidWait wire format confirmed: [INT32 TimeToAid][UINT32 count]([INT32 respawnerID][WSTRING respawnerName] * count). String names 'TimeToAid'/'respawners'/'respawnerID'/'respawnerName' at 0x019B4670/7C/88/94.

Client respawn trigger: Lua PlayerDefeat.lua callForAid -> Lua_callForAid (0x00aa1c00) -> EmitNetOut_callForAid (0x00aea880) -> Event_NetOut_callForAid CME signal -> RouteOutgoingEntityRpc (0x00c6fc40) -> cell method 67 (CALL_FOR_AID).
Auto-respawn (method 70 RESPAWN) triggered by client timer expiry — no separate function, same handle_respawn() code path with respawner_id=-1.
GiveRespawner flow: server emits Event_NetOut_GiveRespawner via EmitNetOut_GiveRespawner (0x00c81430). Carries single field 'aRespawnerMobID' (entity id of the granted respawner).

Same-world respawn: CellToBaseMsg::ReanchorPlayer. No RESET_ENTITIES. Stats reset, state flags cleared, position updated, CREATE_BASE_PLAYER + VIEWPORT + CREATE_CELL_PLAYER + FORCED_POSITION + appearance replay.
Cross-world respawn: CellToBaseMsg::GateTravel — full instance teardown unavoidable.
